capacity:direct.title: Direct function can't keep up
capacity:direct.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 6/s and handles 2/s (300%): 4/s may be rejected.
capacity:direct.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.
capacity:direct.shownMessage: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 6/s and handles 2/s (300%): 4 req/s may be rejected.

dead-letter:queue.title: Async buffer has no dead-letter queue
dead-letter:queue.message: If Bounded async invoker can't handle a message, it's dropped after 3 deliveries. A command queue is where losing messages hurts most.
dead-letter:queue.rationale: A message that keeps failing is redelivered up to the broker's delivery limit, then goes to the broker's dead-letter route, or is dropped when there isn't one (or its filter doesn't take the message). A dead-letter queue keeps it to inspect and replay.
